phase_boundary.collection: Raw attempt-local waveform collection and formal return remain complete, unbounded and non-truncated.
phase_boundary.review: Query exact signal sets and time windows; write one immutable chunk immediately and atomically advance the small current index.
phase_boundary.retention: Only after terminal family review plus family and mainline consumption may an unprotected heavy raw return be retired.

review_order: existing observer and registered event receipt
expand only while two or more candidates remain

required: complete transitions for the declared signal/time window
unique_root_stop.effect: Stop further waveform scanning for the diagnosis objective; do not promote natural terminal, formal D, E3, E4 or E5.

heavy_raw_slots_per_family_track.selection: Oldest registered entry among terminal-reviewed, family+mainline-consumed, unprotected non-anchor returns.
heavy_raw_slots_per_family_track.when_no_safe_candidate: Fail closed and require role rebalance or external cold archive; never delete an anchor blindly.

before_delete: recheck exact regular return ZIP under declared storage root
build deterministic core-only ZIP with every non-waveform member
embed original return and waveform identities
retirement.delete_scope: One exact consumed local return ZIP only; never a directory, package, task record, report, core return or server state.
retirement.recoverability: Raw waveform is explicitly not locally recoverable after retirement.

activation: post_adjudication_returns_only; no current package rebuild and no server action
claim_boundary: Local review continuity and storage lifecycle only; family diagnosis authority and all dynamic correctness gates remain unchanged.
